title: Unit 10: Keep Healthy: Past Perfect & Health Vocabulary
objective: Mampu memahami dan menggunakan Past Perfect Simple dan Past Perfect Continuous untuk menceritakan pengalaman masa lalu, serta menguasai kosakata kesehatan dan ekspresi waktu (time linkers) dalam konteks berbicara tentang kesehatan.

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan dua bentuk Past Perfect: Simple dan Continuous. Past Perfect Simple digunakan untuk menceritakan kejadian yang terjadi sebelum kejadian lain di masa lalu. Past Perfect Continuous digunakan untuk menceritakan aksi yang berlangsung dalam periode waktu tertentu di masa lalu. Unit ini juga mencakup kosakata kesehatan (illness collocations) dan time linkers (when, as soon as, then, until, while) untuk menghubungkan peristiwa.
rules: Past Perfect Simple: had + past participle. Contoh: She had returned from Alaska when her doctors told her that she had cancer. (Kejadian 'returned' terjadi sebelum 'told')
Past Perfect Continuous: had been + verb-ing. Contoh: They had been waiting for this moment for years. (Aksi 'waiting' berlangsung dalam periode waktu sebelum momen tertentu)

Time linkers menghubungkan urutan peristiwa: when (ketika), as soon as (segera setelah), then (kemudian), until (sampai), while (sementara). Contoh: When I finished the book, I went out and bought binoculars.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Urutan Waktu yang Salah
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering keliru menggunakan Past Perfect ketika tidak ada hubungan 'sebelum-sesudah' yang jelas antara dua kejadian. Past Perfect hanya digunakan jika satu kejadian terjadi sebelum kejadian lain di masa lalu.
commonTrap.wrong: I had eaten breakfast this morning. (tidak ada kejadian kedua sebagai acuan)
commonTrap.correct: I had already eaten breakfast when she called me. (ada dua kejadian dengan urutan jelas: makan sarapan terjadi sebelum dia menelepon)

vocab.collocation: Her doctor gave her medication and she got better immediately.
If you have a problem with your eyes, make an appointment with a specialist soon!
I ate seafood for dinner. I've been feeling sick all night.
When you have a cold, what do you do to get better?
Are you sure it's a cold? Maybe you should see a doctor.
Jack had been suffering from a serious illness since he was born.
When she got the bad news, she took some time to recover and then started travelling.
Exercise strengthens your immune system and helps you fight colds.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara dua teman yang mendiskusikan pengalaman sakit di masa lalu dan bagaimana mereka pulih.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: I felt really sick last week after I had eaten some seafood.
lines.translation: Aku merasa sangat mual minggu lalu setelah aku makan seafood.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Oh no! What did you do? Did you see a doctor?
lines.translation: Oh tidak! Apa yang kamu lakukan? Apakah kamu periksa ke dokter?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Yes, I made an appointment immediately. The doctor gave me medication.
lines.translation: Ya, aku langsung membuat janji temu. Dokter memberi aku obat.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Did the medication help? Are you feeling better now?
lines.translation: Apakah obatnya membantu? Apakah kamu merasa lebih baik sekarang?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Yes, I got better after a few days. I had been feeling sick all night before I went to the doctor.
lines.translation: Ya, aku membaik setelah beberapa hari. Aku sudah merasa mual sepanjang malam sebelum aku pergi ke dokter.

speakingLab.context: Simulasi percakapan dengan tutor AI tentang pengalaman kesehatan dan kebiasaan sehat siswa

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to talk about health. Have you ever felt sick after eating something? What happened?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I felt sick after I had eaten too much spicy food last month.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. That must have been uncomfortable. What did you do to get better? Did you take any medication or see a doctor?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I didn't see a doctor. I just rested at home and drank a lot of water. I got better after two days.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's good to hear. Now, what do you usually do to stay fit and healthy? Do you exercise regularly?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I try to exercise three times a week. I also eat fruit every day to strengthen my immune system.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent habits! Those are really good for your health. Keep it up!

quiz.question: Which sentence uses Past Perfect Simple correctly?
options: She had returned from Alaska when her doctors told her the news.
She has returned from Alaska when her doctors told her the news.
She returned from Alaska when her doctors had told her the news.
quiz.answer: She had returned from Alaska when her doctors told her the news.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect Simple (had returned) digunakan untuk kejadian yang terjadi sebelum kejadian lain di masa lalu (told). Kejadian 'kembali dari Alaska' terjadi sebelum 'dokter memberi tahu berita'.

quiz.question: Complete: They ________ for this moment for years before the operation happened.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect Continuous (had been waiting) digunakan untuk aksi yang berlangsung dalam periode waktu (for years) sebelum momen tertentu di masa lalu (the operation).

quiz.question: Which collocation is correct?
quiz.explanation: Kolokasi yang tepat dalam bahasa Inggris adalah 'take medication' (minum/mengonsumsi obat), bukan 'do' atau 'have' medication.

quiz.question: Choose the correct time linker: I never really liked birdwatching ________ I read the book.
quiz.explanation: 'Until' (sampai) menunjukkan bahwa situasi 'tidak suka birdwatching' berlangsung sampai kejadian 'membaca buku' terjadi. Setelah membaca buku, situasinya berubah.

quiz.question: What does 'get better' mean in: When you have a cold, what do you do to get better?
quiz.explanation: Dalam konteks kesehatan, 'get better' berarti pulih atau sembuh dari penyakit (recover from illness).

quiz.question: Which sentence shows Past Perfect Continuous correctly?
options: Jack suffered from a serious illness since he was born.
Jack had been suffering from a serious illness since he was born.
Jack has been suffering from a serious illness since he was born.
quiz.answer: Jack had been suffering from a serious illness since he was born.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect Continuous (had been suffering) digunakan untuk aksi yang berlangsung dalam periode waktu di masa lalu (since he was born). Konteks cerita menunjukkan ini adalah masa lalu, bukan present perfect.
